excluded_stratum_reason: 100%-take-all protected stratum (hiberno_english.sampling.e390._neyman fixes H_multisense's allocation to its ENTIRE population): E390 already contains all 63 multi-sense entries in the corpus, leaving zero remaining for H. Not a shortfall -- mathematically exhausted.
override_mechanism: none -- draw_h390 has no post-draw override; the realised size either equals the budget exactly or the draw is rejected
reference_scaffold_note: Entry-schema skeletons only (entry_id/entry_type/homonym_index/provenance.source_span/witness_id); every extraction field left at its empty schema default for human adjudication. Contains no dictionary prose -- an adjudicator locates each entry in frozen/source_witness.docx via provenance.source_span.locator. Never filled from RB or LLM output. Not frozen/complete -- an independent adjudication pass must populate it before any held-out scoring against H.

sampling_design_provenance.nominal_allocation_derivation: explicit, externally-decided redistribution of E390's H_multisense realised allocation (63, now fully exhausted / 0 remaining) proportionally across the other seven strata, weighted by each stratum's own E390 realised count; H_homonym (20, not the raw proportional value 19) and H_pointer (23, not 24) were adjusted from the raw proportional split specifically so the whole-homonym-group draw reconciles to exactly 390 without splitting any group; not computed by this codebase's Neyman allocation

sampling_frame_definition: D \ E390 (the 3,509 canonical lexical entries not selected into the frozen 390-entry E390 development set)
